scope: Algebraic audit of already bound pad_slot_bound; no experiment or optimizer execution
assumptions: first day-ahead plan; no ongoing pre/air/post records
each carrier has one pad; pre/post and both protection traversals occupy it
carrier stationary during each protection traversal
vertical center displacement from dock to safe height is 4 m; absolute vertical speed <=1 m/s
proof: L_v*(hpre+hpost+2*rise/vzmax) <= Kpad_v*H; floor(28800/368)=78. Slots are optional and unassigned; no arbitrary catalogue is imposed by this bound under the stated day-ahead assumptions.
limitations: Do not apply unchanged to partially executed replans
This proof does not certify road-phase counts, charging-event counts, polynomial restriction or delayed constraint completeness
At most 156 possible new flights does not imply any feasible regional plan is found
